summary: Anterix Inc. filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026 disclosing that its board authorized a new share repurchase program on September 16, 2026, effective September 22, 2026, after the prior program expires September 21, 2026. The company may buy up to $250,000,000 of common stock through September 22, 2029 via open market or privately negotiated transactions, including Rule 10b5-1 plans. Timing and amount remain discretionary; the program can be suspended or modified. Watch buyback pace versus free cash flow and Spectrum Enterprises monetization proceeds.
